caption: The drawing consists of a finely detailed, tall cylindrical container with a domed, perforated lid featuring a pointed knob at the top and a small hinge on the side. It has a single, ornate curved handle attached to the right side, which ends in a small decorative flourish. The container sits upright on a simple flat base with slight step-like grooves at the bottom. The main depiction is centered within a large square border, drawn in fine pencil lines on a light, off-white background. In the bottom-left corner inside the main border, there is a smaller, simplified version of the same object depicted in outline, showing the same container in side profile. The artist’s signature and the year “1931” are written in the lower right corner in small, neat handwriting. The entire composition is monochromatic, using only shades of gray pencil on paper.
title: Silver Salt Cellar
